Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		pc: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id>0
	postcondition:
		if pc.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let newPC: ProductCatalog in
		newPC.oclIsNew() and
		newPC.Id = id and
		newPC.Name = name and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newPC) and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif 
}
